$comment: Registry of visual regression flows. Each flow is one integration_test file driven end-to-end via flutter drive, producing one or more named screenshot checkpoints. Run a subset with: dart run test/visual/tooling/run_visual_tests.dart --tags <tag>[,<tag>...]

flows.name: smoke_app_launch
flows.description: App boots against the real gatherli-dev Firebase project and reaches its initial screen.

flows.name: auth_login_and_navigation
flows.description: Logs in with a seeded user, walks every bottom-nav tab, then logs out.

flows.name: auth_signup
flows.description: Drives the real registration form and captures the resulting email-verification prompt on the home screen.

flows.name: community_friends_and_group
flows.description: Seeds 8 users, demonstrates friend request send/accept via real UI, and creates a group with all 8 as members.

flows.name: game_workflow_male
flows.description: Full-depth male pickup game: create, join, submit/verify score, and confirm ELO propagation to Home, Group activity, My Games, Stats and Game Results.

flows.name: game_workflow_female
flows.description: Lighter-depth female pickup game: create, join, submit/verify score, confirm ELO change on Home and Game Results.

flows.name: game_workflow_mixed
flows.description: Mixed-gender pickup game: confirms ELO is intentionally NOT calculated (eloCalculated: true, eloUpdates: {}).

flows.name: training_workflow_completed
flows.description: Create a training session, have all 4 users join, force it into a completed state, and confirm propagation to group Activities and Home (no scores/ELO involved).

flows.name: training_workflow_cancelled
flows.description: Lighter-depth: creator cancels a training session via the real UI, confirms status and propagation to group Activities.

flows.name: championship_workflow
flows.description: Full 4-team round-robin championship: create, register 4 teams, start, submit/verify all 6 matches, confirm final standings and champion banner.
